title: Correct pressure equation
description: Essential: The student's final expression for P(t) must be P(t) = P_a * exp(-Rt/V).

title: Correct temperature expression
description: Essential: The student's final expression for T_out(t) must be T_a * exp(2Rt/(5V)).

title: Correct minimum pressure
description: Essential: The student's final expression for P_min must be P_a * (1 + ΔV/V_0)^(-γ).

title: Model of pressure reduction per cycle
description: Important: The solution must derive or state that each pump cycle reduces chamber pressure by a factor of V/(V+ΔV).

title: Application of adiabatic relation
description: Important: For parts (b) and (c), the solution must correctly apply the adiabatic condition (P*V^γ constant or equivalent) for the gas in the pump cylinder.

title: Use of exponential approximation
description: Important: For part (a), the solution must convert the discrete cycle model to a continuous exponential decay using the limit (1+x)^(1/x) → e.

title: Identification of γ for monatomic gas
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly state γ = 5/3 for a monatomic ideal gas when simplifying expressions.

title: Sign error in exponent
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the pressure or temperature time dependence has the wrong sign (e.g., +Rt/V instead of -Rt/V).

title: Confusion between V and V_0
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the expression for P_min incorrectly uses the large chamber volume V instead of the pump's minimum volume V_0.

title: Incorrect adiabatic exponent
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the wrong value of γ is used in the adiabatic relations, leading to an incorrect numerical factor (e.g., 2/5 vs 2/3).
